llm.summary: The skill is a disclosed gateway to the CellCog cloud service; its file upload, file download, browser, and connected-tool capabilities are broad but described and purpose-aligned.

dimensions.detail: The skill can send prompts and tagged local files to an external service, download generated files locally, and optionally use real Chrome profiles or connected SaaS tools. These are high-impact capabilities but coherent with the service's stated purpose and not automatic.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a Markdown-only skill requiring python3 and CELLCOG_API_KEY, with an optional documented pip install of the official cellcog SDK. No bundled executable scripts or install-time code were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions clearly describe when local files are uploaded with SHOW_FILE tags and warn not to attach credentials, private keys, .env files, SSH keys, or other sensitive material. Optional browser and SaaS-tool access is also disclosed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The SDK supports background notification delivery, default downloads under ~/.cellcog/chats, deterministic output paths via GENERATE_FILE, and re-syncing missed files. This persistence is disclosed, but users should keep paths scoped to intended workspaces.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is very broad: offloading many kinds of work to CellCog for multimodal inputs and outputs. That breadth matches the documented capability rather than showing hidden behavior.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending prompts and explicitly tagged local files to CellCog. Use SHOW_FILE only for files you intend to upload, keep GENERATE_FILE paths inside a project workspace, avoid credentials and private keys, and enable browser or connected SaaS tools only for tasks where that access is necessary.
llm.findings:
[PE3] expected: Downgraded: the cited text documents setting a CELLCOG_API_KEY environment variable and where to obtain an API key; it does not instruct reading credential files or stealing credentials.
[SQP-1] expected: Partially accepted as a usability and scoping risk: the description is intentionally broad and may cause over-invocation, but the breadth matches the skill's disclosed gateway purpose.
[RA2] expected: Accepted as a real capability with user caution: SHOW_FILE uploads tagged files and GENERATE_FILE can place outputs at specified paths, but these behaviors are explicitly documented and include warnings about sensitive files.
